evidence: Built a criterion -> public requirement map for all 26 criteria (2 gates, 14 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual). Every graded demand traces to an explicit sentence in instruction.md or hireops_rules.md, a professional default, or the sign-in house convention (SKILL.md known false positive; workbook Internal E28). No criterion requires an exact route, selector, label, field name or golden-only rule: functional/prompt.md 'Shared state' says 'Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording'; app_context.md says 'The app may use any route layout and labels'; visual/prompt.md says 'Layout, labels and styles are the implementer's choice'. MAP (criterion leg -> source). GATES: render, wrong password stays signed out -> security default + sign-in convention; constraints, reload stays signed in and Observer sees the card -> rules s1 roles table (Observer reads the board) + session default. hro_intake_restart: places 0/51/2.5 refused -> rules s2 'a whole number from 1 to 50'; recruiter-as-manager refused -> 'the hiring manager is picked from the hiring-manager accounts'; blank title -> 'A job has a title' (default); invalid/case-duplicate email refused at the field with the form kept -> rules s2 'we treat upper and lower case as the same ... tell us at that field and keep whatever was typed'; bottom of Applied -> 'starts at the bottom of Applied'; restart/no reseed -> instruction 'Load ... once ... keep new work across restarts'; seeded facts (Platform Engineer Applied Greta/Ade/Marco, Screen Priya/Samuel; Noor's note text) verified against seed_data.json APP-105/106/108, APP-103/104 and notes[0]. hro_moves: one stage at a time, skips refused, ordinary controls, shown at once, arrival at bottom, shared up/down re-order -> rules s3 'Moving a card', 'Order inside a stage', 'Shown at once'. hro_reject_reopen: blank reason refused, reopen only to the rejected-from stage, reason cleared, Hired cannot be rejected, undo of reject/reopen restores reason -> rules s3 + Undo ('rejecting or reopening a card counts as a move', 'gives back a rejection reason the move removed'); readable rejected-from stage -> 'We like to know where a card was when it was rejected', with lenient sources incl. the Activity line; apps whose reopen takes no stage are covered by functional/prompt.md 'Where neither the UI nor any observed request shape can express the forbidden target ... that leg passes'. hro_two_people: 409, nothing changed, names who -> rules s3 'Two people at once' (explicit version + 409 + 'by whom'); 15 s live update -> instruction + rules s5. hro_interview_places: refusal, put back, reason, focus on that card -> rules s3 'Interview places' and 'Shown at once, put back' ('keep my keyboard focus on that card's controls'), with two lenient UI alternatives; undo refused when it would overfill -> Undo paragraph. hro_bulk: board order not selection order, all-or-none, places counted for the set -> rules s3 'Moving several together'. hro_undo: once only, only the latest move, refused after another person's move/re-order/reject/reopen, a note does not count -> Undo paragraph verbatim. hro_activity: a line per opening/addition/move/rejection with reason/reopen/re-order/undo, newest first, job filter, refused actions leave no line, notes not required -> rules s4. hro_manager_roles: HM only on own jobs and only among Interview/Offer/Hired, rejects from Interview/Offer, reopens those, notes on own jobs, opening a job refused ('Only recruiters open jobs') -> rules s1 table + s3 'Who may move what'; HM add-candidate refusal -> rules s1 table (Recruiter 'adds candidates') + s2 'A recruiter adds a candidate' + 403 rule (inferred but grounded). hro_readonly_roles: 401/403/404 -> rules s1 verbatim; Observer write controls explicitly the app's choice. hro_messaging: literal plain text, non-blank, line breaks, Enter/Shift+Enter, box empty and focused, send clears draft, participation per role, 404 for a candidate -> rules s6 'Who takes part', 'Messages', 'Drafts' + s1 404 rule. hro_drafts -> rules s6 Drafts. hro_long_thread: 30 newest oldest-first scrolled to newest, 30 at a time, remaining count, place kept, told how many new, draft/focus kept, unread until read -> rules s6 'Long conversations' + 'Unread' + s5. hro_unread_seen: per-person counts, own messages never unread, open-at-newest reads, Observer never counts, HM/recruiter seen -> rules s6 'Unread'/'Seen'; Lena=1 verified (reads USR-CAN3 APP-301 read_count 2 of 3 messages, third sent by USR-REC3). hro_candidate: wording table, Noor/Tomas statuses verified (APP-101 INTERVIEW Infrastructure, APP-302 APPLIED Design, APP-201 SCREEN Finance Systems), forbidden fields incl. board positions and rejected-from stage -> rules s7 verbatim; board/Activity replays allow refused or own-view-only (more lenient than the brief). POLISH: live_board (open card, unsaved note, focus, caret, scroll) -> instruction 'without closing the card I have open, wiping the note I am typing or moving my cursor' + rules s5; live_thread -> rules s6 'if I'm at the newest message, it's shown'; earlier_place -> 'the message that was at the top of my view stays where it was'; failed_send -> 'leave it in the box and tell me it wasn't sent'; session_resume (sign-in prompt on the next server action, draft restored, other user sees none, note drafts private and kept) -> rules s6 Drafts + s3 notes 'keep it for me on that browser until I do ... nobody else who signs in on that browser sees it' + instruction 'get signed out; when I sign back in it is still there'. VISUAL: Likert craft only; no phone layout or theme required (matches instruction 'We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout'). Colderwater lesson 1 checked for every instance: no stricter criterion lacks a matching brief sentence. CONFORMING-ALTERNATIVE PROBES: (a) reopen with no stage choice -> covered by the prompt rule; (b) UI that blocks a full-Interview move before sending, or does not offer it -> explicit alternatives in hro_interview_places; (c) Observer UI showing write controls -> 'app's choice'; (d) Activity combining a multi-card move into one line -> explicitly accepted; (e) drag-only board -> correctly fails because the brief requires ordinary controls. BROKEN-APP PROBE: an app using from-stage freshness instead of a version passes naive checks but fails hro_two_people's ABA replay, which the brief explicitly requires ('every card carries a version that changes whenever the card moves'); that is a required, not unrequired, demand. NON-BLOCKING NOTES (no fix required): N1 hro_pol_live_board assumes card details and board are visible together ('Once the move is visible on this page'); an app whose card details replace the whole board could score 0, but the brief itself places the update 'on my board ... without closing the card I have open', so this is grounded. N2 hro_messaging grades Noor's send into Tomas's conversation as 404; the brief's 404 rule names 'an application that isn't theirs' and each conversation belongs to an application, so this is a grounded inference. N3 hro_manager_roles' HM add-candidate refusal relies on the role table plus the 403 rule rather than an explicit 'hiring managers may not add candidates' sentence; grounded. No configured judge or Oracle run exists (raw-evidence-index scope), so absence of false-fails on the golden is source-analysed, not measured; that measurement belongs to the runtime rows and is not waived here.
